messages:
Alex: Heads-up — saw a ~12% jump in hosted token cost last night. Cluster telemetry shows ~40% spot evictions in us-west1 between 02:00–04:00. Interactive latency SLOs dipped. Need a hedging/reserve plan.
Maya: Yeah spotted that in the dashboard too. Mixed-capacity policy is working but we got a burst outside expected distributions. My proposal: keep a small on‑demand reserve pool (10–15 nodes) pinned for interactive lanes, route by latency SLO, let batch use spot with relaxed SLOs + retries.
Sam: Agree. Two quick wins: (1) predictive draining + earlier checkpointing for long batch jobs; (2) broaden instance-type and region mix to reduce correlated evictions. Spot churn seems regional.
Jules: Would also recommend shifting more non-urgent batch into an off‑peak window (00:00–06:00) and expose an opt-in discount for customers who choose off-peak. Low friction, immediate cost benefits.
Ken: I'll sketch an autoscaler tweak. Minimal on-demand floor + weighted region routing. Example config for discussion:
```yaml
autoscaler:
  min_on_demand: 12
  spot_fallback_policy: gradual
  region_weights:
    us-west1: 0.45
    us-central1: 0.35
    europe-west1: 0.20
  eviction_safety_margin_secs: 120
  warm_pool: 3
```
Maya: Nice. Add `warm_pool` so we don't cold-start interactive tasks. Also increase checkpoint frequency for >4h batches.
infra-bot: ALERT: 1851001200 - eviction_spike detected (us-west1, gpu-a100) — 40 evictions in 10m. Notified oncall.
Alex: @Ken can you open the PR for the autoscaler change and run a canary on staging tonight? We need metrics to decide thresholds.
Ken: On it. PR in a few hours. Will run canary with: `./deploy autoscaler --canary --region us-central1` and pin critical routes to the on-demand reserve. Will also add a fallback to a smaller quantized model to keep latency under SLO during transient capacity loss.
Sam: We should create a short synthetic trace job to simulate the burst pattern and measure cost + latency impact of different min_on_demand values. I can run that overnight.
Jules: If the simulation shows >8% cost delta vs current, propose we push the reserve policy into production but gate it with a rollout flag and 1h canary.
Maya: Also update the routing policy docs and add a dashboard: `%interactive served from on-demand` by minute. Alert if <95% for 5m.
Alex: Sounds good. Action items:
- Ken: PR + staging canary (today)
- Sam: synthetic trace + results (overnight)
- Maya: update docs + dashboard + checkpoint recommendations (tomorrow AM)
- Jules: write rollout plan + customer opt-in discount note (tomorrow)
Alex: Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Maya: +1 :rocket:
